title: Senior Data Center & Colocation Procurement Specialist (m/w/d) (Einkäufer/in)
description: Akkodis is a global Digital Engineering consulting company that brings technology and talent together to accelerate transformation, drive innovation, and shape a smarter future. With more than 50,000 experts across over 30 countries, we connect industries and technologies, ranging from AI and Data Analytics to Cloud, Edge Computing, Automation, and Cybersecurity.DescriptionThe Data Center & Colocation Category is part of the Cloud Infrastructure team under IT & Cloud and supports SAP's global data center expansion and capacity roadmap. This temporary assignment requires a highly experienced procurement specialist with deep, hands-on expertise in the colocation market. The contractor will advise infrastructure, engineering, finance, legal, and business stakeholders on sourcing strategy and translate complex requirements for capacity, power, location, connectivity, resilience, sustainability, scalability, and deployment timing into commercially robust procurement outcomes.The Senior Data Center & Colocation Procurement Specialist will independently lead complex, business-critical sourcing work for colocation services across regions. The assignment covers the full procurement lifecycle-from market intelligence, supplier shortlisting, RFx design, bid normalization, site and capacity evaluation, and commercial modelling through negotiation and execution of master service agreements, statements of work, order forms, and related amendments. The contractor is expected to challenge requirements constructively, identify commercial leverage, and provide crediblerecommendations with minimal ramp-up or supervision.Key deliverables include category and market insights, sourcing strategies, RFx packages, normalized proposal evaluations, should-cost and total-cost-of-ownership models, negotiation plans, contract positions, executive decision materials, risk assessments, and supplier governance outputs. The contractor must be capable of owning assigned workstreams end to end, navigating ambiguity, and securing competitive outcomes while protecting capacity, service continuity, flexibility, and contractual risk. The engagement does not include ongoing people-management responsibility or independent authority to commit SAP.Key ResponsibilitiesWe are seeking a senior procurement practitioner who has built substantial, recent experience sourcing data center colocation capacity and can contribute immediately. This is not a generalist procurement role. The successful contractor will bring detailed knowledge of the global and regional colocation supplier landscape, commercial structures, capacity constraints, negotiation levers, and contracting risks.The ideal candidate has personally led high-value, multi-site or multi-region colocation transactions and is comfortable engaging directly with major operators and regional providers. They can interrogate technical demand, normalize non-standard proposals, model long-term commercial exposure, negotiate complex protections, and turn incomplete inputs into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders. Success requires an independent, delivery-focused specialist with strong commercial judgment rather than a coordinator or developing category professional.What will you do?- Lead complex global sourcing for colocation capacity, power, connectivity, and related datacenter services.- Develop sourcing strategies using market intelligence, supplier capacity, pricing, and regional risk.- Translate technical and business requirements into effective RFI, RFQ, and RFP processes.- Evaluate proposals and build TCO models covering power, fees, indexation, commitments,ramp schedules, and exit costs.- Lead commercial negotiations on price, capacity, flexibility, service levels, remedies, renewals and termination rights.- Support colocation agreements and order documentation with legal, technical, finance, andbusiness stakeholders.- Assess supplier, site, delivery, resilience, sustainability, and regulatory risks.- Present clear recommendations, benchmarks, trade-offs, and risk mitigations to seniorstakeholders.- Drive savings, supplier governance, procurement documentation, and end-of-assignmenthandover.ProfileRequired Qualifications- 10+ years of experience in strategic procurement, category management, or complex sourcing, including at least 5 years in data center colocation procurement.- Proven experience leading large-scale, international colocation sourcing and contract negotiations.- Strong knowledge of colocation commercial models, cost structures, and data center requirements.- Advanced skills in TCO modelling, cost analysis, benchmarking, scenario analysis, and bid evaluation.- Extensive experience negotiating complex colocation contracts, including SLAs, capacity commitments, pricing, renewals, termination, and liability.- Strong understanding of the global and regional colocation provider market, including supplier evaluation and risk assessment.- Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to work independently in complex environments.- Excellent written and spoken English, including executive-level communication and contract negotiations.- Degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Supply Chain, IT, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; procurement certification is a plus.

title: Haustechniker (m/w/d) (Hauswart/in/Haustechniker/in)
description: Dein Profil- Du besitzt zwei überaus geschickte Hände und weißt, was du tust.- Deine handwerklichen bzw. technischen Fähigkeiten beruhen auch auf einer abgeschlossenen Berufsausbildung.- Du bist bereit, wenn dich andere brauchen und arbeitest nach Prioritäten.- Du verlierst niemals den Überblick, auch wenn manche Aufgaben nicht gleich angegangen werden können oder mehrere Defekte gleichzeitig gemeldet werden.- Du siehst dich als wichtiges Mitglied eines Teams, das unseren Gästen schöne Momente bereitet. Dein Teamspirit ist vorbildlich.- Du scheust den Kontakt mit Gästen nicht, kannst gut mit ihnen kommunizieren und als Gastgeber auftreten.Deine Aufgaben- Du gehst aufmerksam durch das Hotel. Deinem 360 Grad Rundumblick entgeht keine defekte Leuchte, keine auszubessernde Wand und kein tropfender Wasserhahn.- Du bist für die Erhaltung und Verbesserung der Hotelausstattung, Gästezimmer und öffentlichen Bereiche verantwortlich. Dank dir ist immer alles top und funktionstüchtig.- Du bist gemeinsam mit deinem Team erster Ansprechpartner in technischen Fragen - für Kollegen und Gäste - und übernimmst auch Transferfahrten.- Du stehst im Austausch mit externen Technikern, sollte einmal Unterstützung von außen notwendig sein.- Du übernimmst die Pflege der Außenbereiche, mähst im Sommer kleinere Rasenflächen und schiebst im Winter Schnee.- Bereitschaftsdienst (vergütet) ist für dich kein Fremdwort. An einigen Tagen stehst du auch außerhalb der regulären Arbeitszeit auf Abruf für Notfälle bereit.Mehr als nur ArbeitWir haben etwas, was andere nicht haben: ein großartiges Team, das unseren Ostseeblick täglich mit höchstem Anspruch weiterentwickelt. Dafür möchten wir uns mit vielen Vorteilen bedanken.- Weihnachten im Kreis der Familie! Weihnachten bleibt unser Haus geschlossen- Geregelte Arbeistzeiten und flexibles Jahreszeitkonto- Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld- 5-Tage Woche- Moderne Mitarbeiterwohnungen- Mitarbeiterverpflegung- Givve Card als Bezahlkarte mit steuerfreiem Sachbezug nach Betriebszugehörigkeit- Teamcar- Gesundheitsprämie- Monatlicher Gesundheitstag für Mitarbeitende- Kostenfreies Training im hauseigenen Fitnessstudio- Sprachkurse- Vergünstigungen auf F&B und Spa- Leistungen- Attraktive Family&Friends Tarife auf F&B und Logis- Teamevents- Unterstützung von sozialem Engagement und Vereinstätigkeit- Angenehmes Arbeits- und Betriebsklima in einem familiengeführten Hotel- Gute berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten- Gesicherter Arbeitsplatz in traumhafter Umgebung

title: Director Global HR (m/f/d) - Technology and Digital Transformation (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Personalmanagement)
description: About the roleThe Director Global HR (m/f/d) - Technology and Digital Transformation will define and lead the global HR technology, AI and digital transformation agenda.The role will shape a modern, scalable and future-ready HR technology ecosystem that improves employee and manager experience, increases HR efficiency and enables data-led decision-making. A key priority will be leading the transition from Workday to SAP SuccessFactors while establishing the longer-term digital HR roadmap. This will include AI, automation, intelligent workflows, self-service and digital adoption across the global HR function.This is your new role- Define and lead the global HR technology, digitalisation and transformation strategy, supported by a clear multi-year roadmap and governance model.- Lead the global HR technology landscape, including SAP SuccessFactors, and oversee the transition from Workday to SAP SuccessFactors.- Drive major HR technology transformation, migration, optimisation and continuous improvement programmes.- Define and embed the HR AI, automation and digital innovation strategy, ensuring responsible governance, security and privacy.- Create simple, digital-first employee and manager experiences through self-service, automation and improved HR processes.- Establish strong governance for HR systems, integrations, data quality, security, reporting and analytics.- Enable workforce insights and data-driven decision-making through effective HR reporting and analytics.- Lead global change management, adoption and capability-building across HR, including AI fluency and digital ways of working.- Partner with HR, IT, Finance, Procurement and business leaders to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.- Build and lead a high-performing HR Technology and Digitalisation function, fostering innovation and continuous improvement.This is you:- You bring 10+ years of experience in HR Technology, Digital HR, HR Transformation or a related field within a large, complex global organisation.- You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (BSc/MSc) in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.- You have a proven track record of leading enterprise-scale HR technology transformations, including major implementations, migrations and platform changes.- You have strong experience with SAP SuccessFactors and/or Workday, combined with a solid understanding of HR systems, integrations and digital HR ecosystems.- You understand HR data, analytics, governance, security, privacy and compliance, and how these enable effective global HR services.- You are passionate about AI, automation and emerging technologies, with the ability to identify opportunities that improve HR efficiency and employee experience.- You can translate digital strategy into clear roadmaps, investment priorities and measurable business outcomes.- You are a strong change leader and communicator, able to influence senior HR, IT and business stakeholders across a global matrix organisation.- You combine strategic thinking with hands-on leadership, building strong teams, challenging legacy ways of working and driving digital adoption and continuous improvement.Why work for us?- lexible working arrangements designed to support a healthy work-life balance.- A permanent employment contract with a competitive salary and attractive employee benefits.- Excellent learning and career development opportunities, supported by the Nexperia Academy and dedicated talent and leadership programmes- Access to a range of additional benefits, which may include retirement provisions, mobility support, employee discounts and wellbeing initiatives, depending on location.- Access to employee assistance and wellbeing support programmes.- Opportunities to connect through social clubs, Employee Resource Groups and global initiatives.- The opportunity to work in a global technology environment, collaborating across functions and regions on strategic transformation initiatives.- A role with significant scope to shape the future of HR technology, digitalisation and AI at Nexperia.Talent acquisition based on Nexperia vacancies is not appreciated. title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description: To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.Your mission- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilitiesYour profile- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)- Fluent in English and preferably GermanBenefits- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discountsYour next step - get in touch!We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. You know how to collaborate with stakeholders, communicate clearly, and balance security requirements with business value and usability. The Information Security Officer closely cooperates with Cyber Security Specialists and other Information Security colleagues in audits, change management, incident coordination, awareness activities, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives. Reports to:Chief Information Security Officer. Key areas of accountability: Risk management and advisory:Identify, assess and document security risks across information processes, projects and technologies within assigned areas of responsibility.Provide constructive security advisory for inquiries related to areas of responsibility, applying established guidelines and escalating complex topics where needed.Collaborate with business stakeholders to provide clear guidance and support the development of pragmatic, risk-aligned solutions.Support mitigation planning by providing input on security risks, controls and improvement actions.Policy management:Write and update security policies, standards and procedures for assigned areas of responsibility.Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security policies, standards and procedures.Identify gaps in policies, standards and guidelines and propose improvements to reduce security risks. Security awareness:Promote security awareness by delivering training and championing Information Security objectives.Assess current security awareness maturity in assigned areas and use insights to drive targeted improvements and clear communication.Support the adoption of the right security behavior based on JBT Marel’s policies, standards and guidelines. Reporting, audits and operations:Report on security posture and incidents within assigned areas of responsibility.Participate in technical and non-technical audits, change management processes and incident coordination activities.Apply established guidelines to analyze and resolve routine security issues.Identify opportunities for control enhancement and process improvement in assigned areas of responsibility.Support continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture and monitor advancements in Information Security best practices.Team contribution:Operate with moderate supervision and seek guidance where needed.Support onboarding or training of new team members when requested.Provide input to employee performance evaluations as needed.Competencies and Skills:     Relating and networkingPresenting and communicating informationWriting and reportingAnalytical thinkingCooperativePro-activeConceptual/forward thinkingThoroughnessStress managementPragmatic and risk-based mindsetProficient English writing and speakingLevel of Knowledge and Experience:Bachelor level in information management and auditing, IT/information security, computer sciences, or a suitable combination of formal education and experience.1 - 3 years of experience in information security, risk management, IT audit, technology governance or a related field.Basic understanding of risk management, security policy management, security awareness, incident coordination and control improvement.Knowledge of international security standards or frameworks, such as ISO 27001, IEC 62443, OWASP, CIS Controls, NIST or ISF Standard of Good Practice, is desired.Preferred: experience in working in an international/ global organization.Preferred: knowledge of the manufacturing industry and business model/processes.Why Join JBT Marel?Joining JBT Marel means becoming part of a global leader in food processing technology that is helping feed the world more sustainably. You'll collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple countries, work on strategic global initiatives, and have opportunities to develop your career in an innovative, purpose-driven organization committed to continuous improvement, customer success, and operational excellence. Interested?📧 Apply by clicking the link to access the vacancy on JBT Marel´s website: https://jbtm.wd108.myworkdayjobs.com/JBT_Marel_Career_Site/job/IS---Gardabaer/Information-Security-Officer--Junior-_25689.🌐 Learn more about us at: JBTMarel.com🔗 Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/jbtmarel/Last application date is November 17, 2026. Join us - and help shape the future of maintenance excellence at JBT Marel.Use of Technology in Our Hiring ProcessJBT Marel uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support the review of applications.These tools help our recruiting teams identify skills and experience relevant to the role based on job-related criteria.All applications are reviewed by people, and AI is not used to make hiring decisions independently. We are committed to fair, consistent and inclusive hiring practices globally.

facilities within Alvotech.• Support and provide QA oversight with review and approval of qualification documents for facility, utility, equipment and computerized systems as applicable.• Contribute Management of Alvotech• Responsible for ensuring all facilities, utilities, equipment, computer systems are appropriately validated and qualification in line with current EU and US legislation for parenteral/biologics.Minimum education and experience required for the role:• A bachelor's degree within relevant area, or other relevant business experience• Minimum 5 years of experience within the Pharmaceutical or Medical Device Industry (preferably in parenteral/biologics formulations).• Experience working with regulatory requirements in GxP required (Preferably FDA and EU regulations).• Good understanding of GAMP 5 guide required.• Knowledge of and experience with validation and qualification specifically within facility, utility, and equipment/computer systems.What we offer:•     An inspiring challenge to work with great co-workers on ambitious projects that change people's lives.•       The chance to be a part of a global and fast-growing company.•       An international work culture that encourages diversity, collaboration and inclusion.•       Positive, flexible, and innovative work environment.•       Support for personal growth and internal career development.•       Company social events and milestone celebrations.•       Excellent in-house canteen and coffee house.•       Exercise and wellbeing support for full-time employees.•       On-site shower facility.•       Transportation grant towards eco-friendly modes of travel for full-time employees.•       Internet at home for full-time employees.About Us: At Alvotech, we are building a global biotechnology company with a clear purpose: to expand access to high-quality, affordable biologic medicines for patients worldwide. Our people are central to that mission. Across our global teams, we bring together expertise in science, manufacturing, quality and commercial operations to shape the future of biosimilars.We offer a dynamic, fast-moving environment where curiosity, initiative and ownership are encouraged. Rooted in Icelandic values and operating on a global stage, we value collaboration, diversity and integrity across everything we do. Our teams work on meaningful challenges, contribute directly to patient impact, and grow alongside the business.Whether you are at the start of your career or looking to take your next step, Alvotech offers the opportunity to do work that matters, in a company driven by purpose and scale.If you do not see a role that matches your experience today, we still welcome general applications from individuals who share our ambition and want to help improve access to biologic medicines worldwide.Please contact: hr@alvotech.com to apply for the position. title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Du leder teamet i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att varje servering håller en jämn och mycket hög nivå.Rollen omfattar bland annat:    Ledning, utveckling och motivation av köksteamet    Utveckling av säsongsbaserade menyer    Kvalitetssäkring och konsekvent nivå i varje servering    Planering, struktur och ett effektivt arbetsflöde i köket    Nära arbete med lokala och hållbara råvaror    Att vidareutveckla restaurangens identitet och gastronomiska riktning    Att skapa en professionell, trygg och inkluderande kökskulturVEM SÖKER VI?Vi söker dig som är kreativ, ambitiös och trygg i ett professionellt kök. Du har en stark bakgrund inom fine dining och förstår de krav på precision, kvalitet och helhetsupplevelse som ställs på MICHELIN Guide-nivå.Du kan redan arbeta som Head Chef, men vi välkomnar även en mycket skicklig Sous Chef som är redo att ta nästa steg in i en ledande roll.Vi tror att du har:    Gedigen erfarenhet från fine dining eller annan gastronomisk verksamhet på hög nivå    Erfarenhet av menyutveckling och arbete med säsongsbaserade råvaror    Ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap    Förmåga att skapa struktur, kvalitet och arbetsglädje i köket    Ett genuint intresse för hållbarhet och lokala råvaror    Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med kvalitet, ekonomi och stabil drift    God kommunikativ förmåga i en internationell arbetsmiljöErfarenhet från en Michelin-restaurang eller motsvarande gastronomisk nivå är meriterande, men rätt potential, ledarskap och ambition kan vara lika viktigt.ETT KÖK MED EN STARK KVINNLIG TRADITIONUnder de senaste tio åren har restaurangens kök bestått av ett kvinnligt team. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. product owners and other engineering leads.Own reliabilityRun the incident management process: on-call rotations and expectations, escalation paths, alerting, and blameless postmortems.Guide production change management, setting policy on deployment reviews, maintenance windows, and rollback plans, and so on.Define and track SLIs and SLOs for core services and set team priorities in response.Own the platformGuide architecture for our on-premise datacenter and AWS environments, and how traffic moves between them.Oversee hardware lifecycle: procurement, bare-metal provisioning, firmware and OS updates, and decommissioning.Own network design and security across both environments, from Cisco routers and firewalls to VPCs, Transit Gateways, and access controls.Push for automation wherever possible, in provisioning, configuration, CI/CD, and observability, to minimize engineering TOIL.Own the budgetSet the cloud and on-premise infrastructure budgets, and forecast Profile:Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years in infrastructure, systems, site reliability, or distributed systems engineering.2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.Strong grasp of distributed systems — message queues, service discovery, consistency, failure modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation providers.Deep cloud provider experience, especially in networking and security (VPCs, Transit Gateways, routing, security groups) and running services at scale.Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, routing protocols such as BGP, VLANs, firewalls, and router configuration.Experience leading incident response and building on-call and postmortem practices.Comfort reading and reviewing code in driving complex, cross-functional technical projects across multiple project and executive stakeholders.Nice to have:Experience with RabbitMQ, NATS, or other message brokers in production.Experience with DynamoDB and Redis.Automation with Python and Ansible.Bare-metal provisioning with PXE boot, Tinkerbell, or similar tools.Infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD with TeamCity or GitHub A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

title: Team Leader
description: Estimated start date: 02/01/2027Minimum rate for this position is €38,691 per annum.Job Location: Sanas Community Services Limited, Hibernia House, Jamestown Road, Finglas Co. Dublin, D11PX08Company description:Sánas provides an alternative respite service for children and young adults. Through our centres we provide a range of relaxing and engaging activities, as well as supporting engagement in local amenities. We are welcoming applications for our centre in Finglas, Co.Dublin.Team Lead – Job description:Sánas provides alternative respite support for children and young adults with intellectual disabilities and/or autism.We are looking for a motivated candidate who believes in developing people’s strengths. As the leader of a team of Direct Support Workers, you will provide your team with guidance and support, and ensure that they deliver on our promise of a strengths-based approach with our service users. Your day-to-day focus will be:- Coordinating and managing the daily operations of support services, including the provision of formal supervision and management of a team of Direct Support Workers- To liaise with the service user's family and relevant members of multi-disciplinary teams, community groups and voluntary bodies with the aim of furthering Service User needs- Encouraging a supportive and collaborative culture among your team- Ensuring the ongoing focus on service’ users strengths and uncovering new ways of developing these- Understanding and delivering on Sánas’ core Vision, Mission and Values- Assuming management responsibilities in the absence of the Assistant Service Manager/Service Manager.- Fostering the development of team members to become the next Sánas Team Leaders while we support you on your professional journeyRequirements:-Third level Qualification in Health Care, Social Care, or Teaching.- Experience of management and supervising both individuals and teams- At least 1 year paid or voluntary experience supporting children or young people with additional needs in a care, respite, education or community setting.- Experience providing personal care, including feeding, toileting, hygiene and mobility support- Fluent written and spoken spoken English, to complete daily records and care documentation accurately.- Right to work in Ireland, or eligibility for an employment permit, and willingness to complete Garda vetting before starting.- Ability to work a 40-hour week, including rota-based or flexible hoursDesirable:- Training in positive behavior support (PBS) or de-escalation techniques- Experience using visual supports or other communication supports with children who have communication needs.Benefits:- The successful applicant will be offered an attractive remuneration and benefits package.Informal enquiries to Fia@sanasireland.ie

title: Localization QA Engineer with Norwegian
description: OverviewGlobeTech is a global provider of software localisation, translation, quality assurance (QA) and data analysis services to the multinational IT sector. We provide market-leading solutions to our clients, with the core objective of helping them expand and grow their businesses in an increasingly personalised and data-driven world.Established in 1997 by two expert engineers, our bespoke services have enabled us to expand globally and become a trusted partner to our clients. Why? Because we work with excellent people!Are you ready to start a new career opportunity and relocate to Cork, Ireland? We are looking for talented individuals to join our growing team within the consumer electronics sector.In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with some of the world's most innovative software products, in a dynamic company culture and alongside cutting-edge technologies.You and your team will be responsible for ensuring the quality of a wide variety of software products in your native language. You will also have the opportunity to share your ideas and contribute in a collaborative working environment.Responsibilities* Perform localisation testing on software, printed documents, help content and hardware products. * Report issues identified using internal tools, providing relevant information and suggestions, and following the resolution process through to completion. * Analyse international functionality issues. * Work cross-functionally with international software QA centres, engineering teams, translators and project managers to ensure the delivery of world-class products to international markets. * Design, implement and organise manual test plans. * Create, maintain and execute automated test procedures. * Develop software test automation scripts using technologies such as Swift, Objective-C, Python and Ruby, or other programming languages as required. * Carry out technical software reviews to identify opportunities for test automation. Qualifications* Native-level proficiency in the required language, with a strong understanding of linguistic principles. * Experience in software localisation and/or internationalisation. * An analytical mindset and an interest in identifying software defects and improving product quality. * Strong programming and technical skills. Offer* Working Hours: 10am–6pm, Monday to Friday (39 hours per week). * Salary: €42,000 per annum. * Location: Hollyhill, Cork. * Eircode: T23 YK84* Employer: GlobeTech. * Contract: 6-month contract, with the possibility of extension.

You will make sure all of the client's needs are met in a completely individual way, and as an ambassador of Resilience's values, you will representBest Quality - providing best-in-class care always.Individuality - applying a person-centered approach to meet each individual's abilities, needs and challengesEmpowerment - helping all our service-users live their very best life and achieve their optimal potential.What Will Your Responsibilities Be?The delivery of client care needs and the development, implementation and evaluation of Support Plans;Ensure that practices within the service comply with Resilience's policies and procedures, to maintain the highest standards;Liaise with Multi-Disciplinary Teams ('MDTs') when required;Provide support to colleagues within the team setting;Act as a mentor for new staff and foster a positive learning environment;Participate in the development and review of risk assessments and report concerns.What is Required?            You will have:FETAC/QQI level 5/Social Care/healthcare assistant qualification or equivalent;Completed or be willing to complete a Patient Manual Handling course;Eligibility to work in Ireland;A strong sense of empathy, flexibility and a team-oriented work ethic.Previous experience working with adults/children with physical, sensory and intellectual disabilities would be an advantageA Full Drivers Licence is desirable.How Will You Benefit?This is your opportunity to:Develop and progress your career through full induction, training and ongoing development.Enjoy excellent rates of pay Resilience Rewards employee discounts e.g discounted health insuranceMake your mark as part of a service that is changing the future of care in Ireland.Employee Assistance Programme 24/7Resilience4Me Health and Well-being ForumEnjoy a personal, one-to-one approach to social care support work.Benefit from the full support of management.Earn from our paid Refer-a-Friend scheme

title: commerciante al dettaglio
description: Grafton Retail&GDO* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati nel mondo del retail e della grande distribuzione. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per azienda cliente del settore GDO alimentare, selezioniamo: Direttore di Punto Vendita GDO Ipermercato _ Brescia Sarai inserito/a all'interno di un Punto Vendita di medio-grandi dimensioni, con un ruolo chiave di supervisione e coordinamento delle attività di sala e dei reparti, orientato al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di performance e di servizio. Di cosa ti occuperai? Supervisione e controllo della sala vendita e dei reparti, garantendo standard di ordine, pulizia e qualità del servizio. Verifica giornaliera e settimanale dei principali KPI (prestazioni e livello di servizio), con focus sul raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali. Monitoraggio e coordinamento delle attività del capo-sala e dei capi-reparto, con cui collaborerai nella gestione operativa e organizzativa. Gestione del team: organizzazione dei turni, motivazione delle risorse, inserimento e formazione delle nuove figure, supporto nella gestione di criticità e problematiche organizzative. Applicazione delle linee guida commerciali e presidio della corretta esecuzione delle attività in store. Garanzia del rispetto di regole e procedure aziendali. Responsabilità sul corretto funzionamento e manutenzione di attrezzature e strumentazioni a supporto delle attività del Punto Vendita. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche Diploma di maturità o Laurea Esperienza pregressa significativa nel ruolo, in contesti di medio-grandi dimensioni o Ipermercato; richiesta provenienza dal settore GDO alimentare Capacità di leadership e gestione di team, buone doti relazionali e comunicative Capacità organizzative e forte orientamento al risultato Problem solving, flessibilità e dinamicità Attitudine alla vendita e all'assistenza al cliente Affidabilità, impegno e responsabilità Proattività, passione e voglia di mettersi in gioco flessibilità sulla provincia di Brescia Orario di lavoro Full-Time, dal lunedì alla domenica, con un giorno di riposo a scorrimento. Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto di assunzione diretta a tempo indeterminato CCNL applicato: Commercio distribuzione e dei servizi - Confcommercio Livello di inquadramento: 1° livello Retribuzione prevista: 40-50K annui lordi Ticket restaurant e valore: 6€ a giornata lavorativa secondo regolamento aziendale Benefit: MBO varia in base al cluster di appartenenza con un minimo di 5000€ ad un massimo di 7000€ al raggiungimento degli obiettivi. L'MBO viene calcolato dal momento in cui la risorsa entra effettivamente nel ruolo dopo il periodo di formazione (6 mesi). Luogo di lavoro: Brescia Se pensi di avere le competenze e l'attitudine per questo ruolo, inviaci la tua candidatura! *Grafton Retail&GDO è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: responsabile della protezione ambientale
description: Grafton Engineering è la specializzazione dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Progettazione, Logistica e Supply Chain, Produzione & Manutenzione, Qualità - Sicurezza e Ambiente, Process & Project Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati: lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso ruoli e contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e aspettative. Per azienda cliente, produttore di energia rinnovabile, selezioniamo: URBANISTA- SPECIALISTA PERMITTING & AUTORIZZAZIONI La risorsa contribuirà alle attività di analisi vincolistica/urbanistica e alla predisposizione degli elaborati progettuali funzionali all'ottenimento delle autorizzazioni per la costruzione di impianti fotovoltaici. Responsabilità principali: Predisposizione, firma e gestione della documentazione tecnico-amministrativa e degli elaborati/tavole progettuali (in coordinamento con l'area tecnica) da inoltrare agli enti competenti per l'ottenimento di AU / PAS / SCIA / DILA e/o iter similari; Analisi urbanistica e catastale dei terreni/aree di interesse (destinazione d'uso, vincoli urbanistici, paesaggistici, ambientali, fasce di rispetto, ecc.); Supporto alle attività di verifica preliminare sulle aree (anche tramite software dedicati e, se necessario, sopralluoghi); Disponibilità a sopralluoghi tecnici e a partecipare a incontri con gli enti coinvolti nei procedimenti autorizzativi. Requisiti fondamentali: Iscrizione all'Albo professionale e abilitazione alla firma della documentazione progettuale/autorizzativa; Partita IVA attiva; Esperienza nella preparazione della documentazione per iter AU/PAS/SCIA/DILA (o procedure equivalenti); Ottima familiarità con software professionali: AutoCAD, pacchetto Office, Google Earth, GIS; Competenza nell'analisi urbanistica e catastale (vincoli e conformità). Offerta: contratto di collaborazione professionale. Modalità di lavoro: full remote con presenza in sede (Folignano) circa 1/2 volte al mese per riunioni di coordinamento. title: tecnico chimico
description: GI GROUP SPA, prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, per un'importante realtà industriale internazionale operante nel settore della produzione di apparecchiature ad alta tecnologia, ricerca un: Analista Chimico Responsabilità: Sviluppo metodi e validazione: sviluppare procedure analitiche per metalli (composizione bulk e tracce) con OES/XRF, combustione ed estrazione a caldo; e per metalli in soluzione dopo digestione con ICP-OES/ICP-MS. Pianificare ed eseguire validazione/verifica (accuratezza, ripetibilità/riproducibilità, linearità, range, selettività, robustezza, carryover, LOD/LOQ) e confermare la tracciabilità metrologica tramite CRM. Definire e mantenere i budget di incertezza di misura (preparazione campione, calibrazione, performance strumentale) in linea con applicazione e decision rule. Redigere e mantenere piani/report di validazione e documenti controllati (SOP/WI) con gestione revisioni e valutazione impatti delle modifiche; Data integrity e gestione dati: garantire acquisizione, elaborazione e reporting secondo procedure controllate (configurazione strumenti, audit trail, versioning, calcoli tracciabili). Eseguire review tecnica e validazione risultati (stato calibrazioni, conformità QC, integrità campioni, controlli di plausibilità). Gestire archiviazione sicura e recupero dei dati grezzi/record con leggibilità nel lungo periodo e accessi controllati. Gestire i dati in modo strutturato con LIMS e fogli validati applicando principi ALCOA++. Condurre indagini e azioni correttive per non conformità, eventi di data integrity o QC fuori specifica; implementare CAPA e verificarne l'efficacia; Esecuzione analisi chimiche avanzate: svolgere analisi con metodi validati, inclusa preparazione campioni (pesata, digestione, diluizione), calibrazione e verifiche QC. Preparare reagenti e standard con tracciabilità documentata; gestire CRM e soluzioni di riferimento (stoccaggio, etichettatura, scadenze). Eseguire controlli di routine e verifiche prestazionali; coordinare manutenzione e troubleshooting con fornitori. Assicurare gestione sicura di chimici e rifiuti (risk assessment, DPI, compliance ambientale e regole di sito); Reportistica e interpretazione risultati: preparare report di prova conformi (identificazione metodo, tracciabilità, stato QC, incertezza quando applicabile). Interpretare risultati per caratterizzazione materiali, monitoraggio corrosione, failure analysis e supporto al processo; comunicare conclusioni agli stakeholder. Supportare definizione di decision rules e dichiarazioni di conformità coerenti con requisiti cliente/norme; Gestione subfornitori e audit: valutare tecnicamente report di laboratori esterni (equivalenza metodo, incertezza, evidenze di tracciabilità, adeguatezza QC). Supportare qualifica e follow-up fornitori come esperto di analisi chimiche; contribuire a preparazione ed esecuzione audit. Supportare audit interni/esterni (enti di accreditamento, clienti) fornendo evidenze oggettive su validazione, incertezza, competenza e data management; Requisiti: Laurea in Chimica, Chimica Analitica, Ingegneria Chimica o diploma 5 anni indirizzo chimico; Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nel ruolo all'interno di laboratori industriali accreditati ISO/IEC 17025; Esperienza diretta in attività di analisi composizione metallica e analisi metalli in matrice acquosa ICP-OES/ICP-MS; Conoscenza livello B2/C1 lingua inglese; Cosa offriamo: Inserimento diretto in azienda; CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria; Retribuzione prevista compresa tra €37.000,00 to €48.500,00 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alla mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. title: direttore dei sistemi informatici/direttrice dei sistemi informatici
description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). title: commerciante al dettaglio
description: Nova Coop: 68 punti vendita, 4.629 dipendenti, 583.000 Soci. Una realtà strutturata, dove la gestione di ogni punto vendita contribuisce concretamente ai risultati dell'intera organizzazione. Per la provincia di Torino cerchiamo: Responsabile di Negozio Esperienza, capacità di coordinare il team, presidiare l'operatività e tradurre gli obiettivi commerciali ed economici in risultati sono le principali caratteristiche della risorsa che cerchiamo. Nova Coop vanta una presenza consolidata sul territorio e una rete di punti vendita distribuita tra Piemonte e Lombardia. Una realtà che lavora ogni giorno per offrire prodotti e servizi competitivi, qualità e sostenibilità degli stessi e iniziative dedicata all'ambiente e alle comunità locali. Il ruolo Come Responsabile di Negozio, sarai il punto di riferimento del punto vendita, con la responsabilità di coordinare la squadra, garantire l'operatività e contribuire al raggiungimento degli obiettivi prefissati. In particolare ti occuperai di: - Coordinare e motivare il team, organizzando attività e orientando il lavoro verso i KPI assegnati; - Garantire l'operatività del punto vendita, presidiare i reparti e gestire correttamente le merci; - Assicurare la qualità del servizio al cliente, gestendo eventuali criticità e reclami; - Monitorare conto economico e KPI, individuando opportunità di miglioramento; - Formare e sviluppare le persone, favorendo collaborazione, autonomia e un clima di lavoro positivo. Il profilo che cerchiamo Cerchiamo una risorsa con esperienza, capace di gestire persone, numeri e priorità in un contesto dinamico. Per avere successo nel ruolo servono: - esperienza pregressa nella gestione dei reparti freschi; - capacità di organizzazione, leadership, coordinamento e gestione del team; - interesse per gli aspetti commerciali e amministrativi e buona conoscenza di Excel; - intraprendenza, autonomia e capacità di problem solving; - disponibilità a spostarsi sui diversi punti vendita della provincia di Torino. Cosa offriamo Un'opportunità di responsabilità all'interno di una realtà strutturata, con un percorso pensato in ottica di continuità. - Contratto a tempo determinato di 12 mesi, full-time 40 ore settimanali, finalizzato alla stabilizzazione a tempo indeterminato; - 1° livello CCNL per dipendenti da imprese della distribuzione cooperativa; - RAL €37.000 - €42.000; - MBO annuale fino al 21% della componente fissa, al raggiungimento dei target assegnati. Luogo di lavoro: provincia di Torino #LI-MU3 Se hai esperienza nella gestione di un punto vendita e cerchi una nuova responsabilità in cui mettere a frutto le tue competenze, questa opportunità potrebbe essere il tuo prossimo passo. Candidati per entrare a far parte del team. Il nostro Gruppo è attivo nei seguenti campi: lavoro temporaneo, Permanent e Professional Staffing, Ricerca e Selezione, Consulenza HR, Formazione, Outsourcing, supporto alla ricollocazione e attività complementari. Siamo presenti in più di 30 Paesi in Europa, Asia e America con un team di oltre 6000 persone. I valori che ci contraddistinguono: attenzione, passione, apprendimento continuo e innovazione, collaborazione, sostenibilità, responsabilità.
