Ditt uppdragSom servicetekniker hos Epiroc arbetar du med service, felsökning, underhåll och reparation av våra maskiner och utrustningar. Beroende på verksamhetens behov och din profil kan du komma att arbeta: •    På Epirocs verkstad i Kiruna med service, reparationer och ombyggnationer av maskiner och komponenter.•    Ute hos kund i gruvmiljö, under jord, där du utför service, felsökning och support nära verksamheten.•    Med förebyggande och avhjälpande underhåll för att säkerställa hög tillgänglighet och driftsäkerhet.•    Med felsökning inom mekanik, hydraulik, el och styrsystem. Oavsett placering blir du en viktig del i arbetet med att säkerställa att maskinerna fungerar säkert och effektivt. Rollen erbjuder stor variation och möjlighet att utveckla bred teknisk kompetens i nära samarbete med erfarna kollegor. Vi erbjuder introduktion, utbildning och stöd från kunniga kollegor som hjälper dig att komma in i rollen och utvecklas tillsammans med oss. Din profilVi tror att du har ett genuint tekniskt intresse och tycker om att förstå hur maskiner fungerar. Du är lösningsorienterad, ansvarstagande och trivs med både självständigt arbete och samarbete i team. Vi ser gärna att du har:•    Erfarenhet av mekaniskt arbete, exempelvis som servicetekniker, mekaniker, fordonsmekaniker eller liknande.•    Grundläggande kunskaper inom mekanik, hydraulik och el.•    God datorvana och förmåga att arbeta i digitala system.•    B-körkort.•    Goda kunskaper i svenska och gärna engelska. Erfarenhet från gruv-, entreprenad- eller industribranschen är meriterande, men inget krav. Har du rätt inställning och vilja att utvecklas får du den utbildning och det stöd som behövs för att lyckas hos oss. Placering och arbetstidTjänsterna är placerade i Kiruna.Vi söker flera servicetekniker till olika delar av verksamheten. Vissa tjänster är kopplade till Epirocs verkstad i Kiruna medan andra innebär arbete ute hos kund i gruvmiljö. Beroende på roll och verksamhetens behov kan arbetstiden vara förlagd till dagtid eller skiftgång.Vi matchar i möjligaste mån kompetens, erfarenhet och intresse mot de olika uppdragen. Livet på EpirocNär du kliver in hos oss på Epiroc blir du en del av ett företag präglat av innovation, samarbete och engagemang. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med världsledande teknik och bidra till utvecklingen av framtidens gruv- och anläggningsindustri. Genom Epiroc Fritid erbjuder vi dessutom aktiviteter och gemenskap utanför arbetet. För den motorintresserade finns ett fullt utrustat garage där medarbetare kan meka med sina egna fordon på fritiden. Det är en uppskattad mötesplats som skapar gemenskap, kunskapsutbyte och möjligheten att dela ett gemensamt intresse med kollegor även utanför arbetsdagen. AnsökanVi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt. Ansökningar granskas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum 2026-12-03. Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vänligen observera att vi på grund av rådande regelverk inte kan hantera ansökningar som skickas in via e-post.Vi har redan tagit ställning till annonseringskanaler och konsultleverantörer och undanber oss därför vänligt från att bli kontaktade i sådana frågor.

title: Global Implementation Specialist
description: About the roleAs a Global Implementation Specialist you will play a key role in developing and continuously improving Instabee's global merchant offering through API integrations. You will be responsible for ensuring a seamless integration experience, enabling merchants to quickly launch and scale Instabee's delivery services across markets.Working closely with our Commercial, Product, Tech and Operations teams, you will act as the link between business needs and technical solutions. You will support complex commercial deals by translating merchant requirements into effective integration solutions, removing technical barriers and accelerating go-to-market timelines.From initial discussions and technical onboarding to launch and ongoing optimization, you will take ownership of the integration journey and build strong, long-term relationships with our global merchants. This is a cross-functional role where you will combine technical understanding, commercial awareness and project management to create scalable solutions and an excellent merchant experience.What you’ll doIn this role, you will:    Drive the technical value proposition in complex commercial deal cycles, aligning integration roadmaps with business objectives to remove technical barriers and accelerate merchant launches.    Take full ownership of onboarding and API integrations for new global merchants, ensuring a smooth and successful launch experience.    Partner closely with Commercial teams to accelerate go-to-market timelines and enable merchants to quickly start using Instabee's services.    Collaborate cross-functionally with Tech, Product and Operations to simplify complex integrations, resolve technical challenges and ensure effective solutions.    Monitor integration performance and analyze relevant data to identify improvement opportunities and continuously strengthen our global integration processes.    Act as a trusted partner to global merchants, building strong relationships and supporting their needs beyond the initial launch.What we're looking forWe believe you are a driven and solution-oriented person who enjoys working at the intersection of technology and business. You are comfortable navigating complex technical discussions, managing multiple stakeholders and taking ownership of projects from start to finish. You combine strong communication skills with a structured approach and a genuine interest in creating great customer experiences.We also believe you have:    A university degree in Business, Engineering or a related field.    4–6 years of relevant experience within e-commerce or logistics, preferably in implementation, Technical Account Management or Commercial Excellence.    A solid understanding of API integrations. Hands-on experience with Postman or similar tools is a plus.    Experience working with global merchants and/or cross-border commercial setups.    Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive initiatives forward in a cross-functional environment.    A commercial mindset and the ability to understand business needs and translate them into practical technical solutions.    Excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.What you’ll getWe can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:    🏢 Brand-New Office — More Space for Our Brilliant People. Soon moving into our new Stockholm HQ, designed to bring our people together to collaborate, connect, create and deliver.    👶 Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.    🎂 A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!    ⏰ Hybrid setup and flexible working hours.Get to know usIn 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. title: Senior LCI Specialist
description: The opportunityHVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group within Hitachi Energy that develops, manufactures, and delivers DC transmission systems worldwide. HVDC technology enables the efficient transmission of electricity over long distances, through submarine cables, and between interconnected power systems.Join our team as a Senior LCI Specialist and help us drive innovation in the Engineering, Procurement and Construction industry!  As part of the LCI team, you will be at the forefront of our efforts to coordinate all activities related to Life Cycle Information (LCI), Asset Information Management (AIM) and Data Quality. Your main responsibility will be to support project execution and ensure effective LCI coordination across all phases of a project, from tendering to final handover to the client.You will play a critical role in aligning data handling strategies and practices with key stakeholders, including the Building Information Modelling (BIM), Service, Digital, and PLM organizations, to ensure we provide the best possible support to our customers and stay ahead in an industry that is increasingly driven by information rather than documents.To succeed in this role, you should be resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced project environment. You need to effectively manage multiple project stakeholders simultaneously and ensure they have everything they need to deliver their part of the project.How you’ll make an impact    Ensure all project stakeholders understand and comply with the client’s LCI/AIM requirements.    Oversee the collection, validation, and maintenance of asset information, including equipment specifications, maintenance records, and performance data.    Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including engineering, operations, maintenance, SCM, and IT teams, to integrate asset information processes into project workflows and systems.    Develop and implement strategies for the successful adoption and integration of LCI/AIM concepts, systems and processes across various functions within Hitachi Energy.    Establish and enforce quality standards for asset data accuracy, completeness, and integrity to support reliable decision-making and regulatory compliance.    Develop and deliver training on LCI/AIM systems and processes in collaboration with the Training Development Lead.    Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and innovation in LCI/AIM practices to drive operational efficiency and cost savings.    Lead and manage LCI related continuous improvement projects from initiation to completion, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.    Maintain effective communication with project stakeholders to ensure alignment on LCI objectives, progress, and outcomes.Your background    Bachelor's degree or higher in engineering, computer science, information management, or a related field. Advanced degree or certification in asset management or data analytics is an advantage.    3-5 years of experience in a senior technical role within Asset Information Management, Life Cycle Information, or related fields in the energy, utilities, or manufacturing industries.    In-depth knowledge of AIM systems and technologies, such as AVEVA AIM, Omega365, IBM Maximo, digital twin platforms or similar solutions.    Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks for asset management, such as IEC 61970-301, ISO 55000 and IEC 62443.    Strong project management skills, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, and risk management.    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels of the organization.    Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.    Demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvement and innovation in LCI/AIM processes and practices.More About Us​We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. title: Operations Analyst
description: About the roleAs an Operations Analyst within Group Operations, you will play an important role in shaping and optimizing Instabee's first- and middle-mile transport network. You will work with strategy, network design and data analysis to improve the efficiency, quality and reliability of our transport routes between merchant warehouses and Instabee terminals across our five markets: Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Norway and the Netherlands.Working closely with our local Market teams, you will identify improvement opportunities, analyze network performance and ensure that the right data, insights and tools are available to support well-informed operational decisions. You will also collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to develop scalable solutions that improve our transport operations and create a great experience for our merchants.You will be part of the First and Middle Mile team within Group Operations, reporting to the First and Middle Mile Manager, who will support your onboarding, learning and professional development.What you’ll doIn this role, you will:    Analyze and design first- and middle-mile transport networks to identify opportunities for improved efficiency, quality and cost performance.    Work closely with local Market teams to understand operational needs, evaluate current performance and drive improvements across our markets.    Develop and maintain the data landscape for first- and middle-mile operations, integrating data from different tools and systems to create valuable insights.    Monitor operational performance and ensure high-quality and reliable transport operations.    Collaborate with colleagues across Tech, Commercial and Integration to ensure that tools and solutions are developed in line with operational needs and provide a great merchant experience.    Build dashboards and analytical tools to support data-driven decision-making and enable best-practice sharing across markets.What we're looking forWe believe you are a curious and analytical person who enjoys solving complex problems and understanding how different parts of a system connect. You combine a strategic mindset with a structured and hands-on approach, and are motivated by turning data and insights into tangible improvements.We also believe you have:    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex challenges and strategic goals into actionable improvements.    A structured and data-driven approach, with great attention to detail and an ability to prioritize initiatives based on their potential impact.    An interest in data analysis and experience working with tools such as SQL and Excel/Google Sheets. Experience with Tableau is a plus.    The ability to evaluate complex, interconnected systems and identify opportunities for optimization.    Strong communication and collaboration skills, allowing you to build relationships and work effectively with stakeholders across different teams and markets.    A genuine curiosity and interest in logistics, transport and operational development.What you’ll getWe can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:    🏢 Brand-New Office — More Space for Our Brilliant People. Soon moving into our new Stockholm HQ, designed to bring our people together to collaborate, connect, create and deliver.    👶 Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.    🎂 A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!    ⏰ Hybrid setup and flexible working hours.Get to know usIn 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.

title: Global R&D Manager Verification and Validation
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:This is a senior and independent leadership position with responsibility for establishing global verification and validation practices across Surface Mining Automation. You will have a unique opportunity to influence technology decisions, quality standards, and release readiness across a portfolio of strategic automation programs. At Epiroc, we're accelerating the transformation of mining through automation and digitalization. As our Global R&D Manager Verification & Validation, you will play a key role in ensuring that our solutions are safe, predictable, compliant, and ready to deliver value for our customers around the world. Join our team You will be part of Surface Mining R&D Automation, a globally connected organization developing autonomous and software-defined mining solutions. Together with colleagues across R&D, Systems Engineering, Product Management, DevOps, and Release Management, we create innovative technologies that improve safety, productivity, and sustainability in mining operations. Your mission As Global R&D Manager Verification & Validation, you will establish and lead a global approach to verification and validation, helping ensure the successful delivery of automation solutions across regions and programs. Your responsibilities will include: Defining and continuously improving a global verification and validation strategy aligned with the V-model.     Leading system- and machine-level verification activities across integrated automation solutions.     Establishing clear release-readiness criteria, quality gates, and data-driven decision frameworks.     Ensuring traceability from requirements to verification results, supported by robust documentation and compliance processes.     Collaborating with engineering teams to identify risks early and improve solution quality from the start.     Enabling scalable verification through reusable test methods, assets, and environments including HiL, SIL, and virtual testing.     Supporting FAT/SAT activities and customer acceptance processes.     Developing global V&V capabilities, common ways of working, knowledge sharing, and a culture of continuous improvement. Profile description:Your Profile We are looking for a collaborative and experienced leader who combines systems thinking with a passion for quality and continuous improvement. You build trust through expertise, communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, and enjoy creating alignment across global teams. You are equally comfortable engaging with senior leaders on strategic priorities as working closely with engineers and technical specialists to drive execution and solve complex challenges. You have a leadership style that inspires confidence, builds engagement, and helps teams successfully navigate change in complex global organizations. With a strong quality mindset and a structured approach, you know how to establish new ways of working, gain stakeholder commitment, and drive sustainable improvements across teams and functions. You are comfortable making informed decisions based on data and evidence while supporting others in finding solutions to complex challenges. To be successful in this role, we believe you bring:     Experience in system-level verification and validation within automation, embedded systems, control systems, software-intensive products, or system integration.     Strong leadership experience in global or cross-functional environments, with the ability to engage and influence diverse stakeholders.     Strong experience leading change management initiatives, including organizational, process, or technology transformations and driving adoption across global teams.The ability to communicate effectively at both strategic and operational levels, translating complex technical topics into clear business insights while building strong relationships with engineering teams.     A strong focus on quality, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.     Knowledge of verification strategies, requirements traceability, system integration, release processes, and verification environments such as HiL, SIL, or simulation-based testing.     Experience with customer acceptance activities, field-deployed automation, compliance, or functional safety is considered an advantage.     A degree in Engineering or a related technical field. Advanced studies and leadership development experience are welcome.     Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.     Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage. Location and travel This position is based in Örebro, Sweden. For the right candidate, a flexible location within one of Epiroc's sites may be considered. International travel of up to 40% is expected. Application and contactsPlease send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 19th of November. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media.

title: Auditeur ou Auditrice interne - 100%
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Auditeur ou Auditrice interne - 100% --- Auditeur ou Auditrice interne \\- 100% ===================================== \*\*Description de l'entreprise\*\* Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant \[ici\](\< ;p8kVMJchPR0\>). La \[Direction de l'audit interne\](\< \>)(DAI) remplit deux catégories de missions : les missions d'assurance (missions d'audit) et les missions de conseil. Dans le cadre de ses missions d'assurance, la Direction de l'audit interne fournit au Comité d'audit un rapport d'audit incluant une évaluation objective sur une entité, un processus, un système ou d'autres domaines en vue de formuler une opinion ou des conclusions. Elle apporte de la valeur ajoutée à l'Institution en prenant en compte la stratégie, les objectifs et les risques, propose des moyens d'améliorer les processus de gouvernance, de management des risques et de contrôle, et fournit avec objectivité une assurance pertinente. L'étendue et la nature de l'exécution des travaux sont déterminées par cette direction. Les missions de conseil ont pour objectif d'améliorer le fonctionnement des HUG. Elles concernent les processus de gouvernance de l'institution, de management des risques et de contrôle interne. Lors de la réalisation d'une mission de conseil, l'auditeur ou l'auditrice interne fait preuve d'objectivité et n'assume aucune responsabilité managériale dans l'activité concernée ni n'interfère avec les prérogatives de celle\\-ci. Rattachée à la présidence du Conseil d'administration, en sa qualité de présidence du Comité d'audit, la Direction de l'audit interne est responsable de l'établissement des politiques d'audit interne, de la définition et du contenu général de ses activités d'audit et de conseil. Elle procède à la planification annuelle des missions d'audit, dont elle requiert l'approbation du Comité d'audit, de leur mise œuvre et de la coordination des travaux relatifs à ces missions et aux missions spécifiques décidées par le Comité d'audit ou avec son aval. Elle s'assure de la réalisation d'audits indépendants et systématiques des processus pour évaluer leur efficacité au vu des objectifs économiques et des risques. Elle informe régulièrement le Comité d'audit de l'avancement des audits en cours en fonction des délais prévus. La Direction de l'audit interne établit le rapport annuel d'activité qui est remis au Comité d'audit puis, après examen et approbation, communiqué au Conseil d'administration. Elle coordonne l'activité de management des risques et du système de contrôle interne dont la mise en place opérationnelle incombe aux référents et aux référentes des départements et directions. \*\*Description du poste\*\* La DAI recherche un ou une auditrice interne pour compléter son équipe composée de 6 auditeurs et auditrices internes. Dans ce cadre, vous avez comme principales missions de planifier, conduire et documenter les missions d'audit selon la méthodologie définie. Vous identifiez et analysez les risques et vous évaluez le système de contrôle interne mis en place par les HUG pour les limiter. Vous rédigez des rapports d'audit pertinents, clairs et succincts avec des recommandations apportant une valeur ajoutée puis vous assurez un suivi des recommandations émises. Vous informez régulièrement le Directeur de la DAI sur le déroulement de vos activités et les faits importants constatés. Vous présentez clairement et succinctement les rapports et constatations au Directeur de la DAI ainsi qu'aux responsables des domaines audités. Par ailleurs, vous êtes une personne référente à l'interne pour toute question, information, documentation liée aux procédures et directives institutionnelles ainsi qu'au cadre légal cantonal ou fédéral. Enfin, vous contribuez à la simplification des processus internes en faisant valoir l'intelligence collective. Vous avez un intérêt marqué par le domaine de la gestion hospitalière au sein d'un hôpital universitaire et souhaitez participer directement à l'amélioration continue de la prise en charge des patients et patientes et de la qualité des soins. \*\*Qualifications\*\* Vous avez une formation professionnelle et/ou académique supérieure, telle qu'un Master en Sciences économiques, un diplôme d'expertise comptable, ou diplôme reconnu équivalent. Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience de 5 ans minimum dans le domaine de l'audit des risques financiers ou dans une fonction d'analyse et de contrôle connexe (Ex. : achats, fournisseurs, révisions comptables, facturation, appels d'offre, logistique ou gestion immobilière) au cours de laquelle vous avez conduit en toute autonomie des missions d'audit. La certification CIA (Certified Internal Auditor) et/ou CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) sont pré\\-requises. Des compétences dans les domaines de cybersécurité, gouvernance des systèmes d'information et protection des données ainsi qu'une expérience des audits des projets informatiques, des transformations numériques et de continuité des systèmes critiques et résilience opérationnels sont des atouts. Vous démontrez une parfaite maîtrise de la comptabilité générale ; une expérience en comptabilité analytique constitue un atout. Être titulaire du certificat ECDL Advanced sur Word, Excel (tableaux croisés dynamiques, macros, calculs automatisés, plannings, graphiques, bases de données...) et Powerpoint est un atout. Vous possédez une grande capacité à gérer le stress et à respecter des délais serrés, tout en assurant des prestations de qualité. Votre excellente aptitude à travailler en équipe vous permet de collaborer étroitement avec les auditeurs et auditrices et les professionnels et professionnelles de santé. Personne dynamique et méthodique, vous faites preuve d'un esprit d'analyse et de synthèse pour faire face à des situations complexes et en constantes évolutions. Organisation, rigueur et sens du détail sont des compétences incontournables pour réussir les missions d'audit et autres activités qui vous sont confiées. Votre aisance relationnelle et votre force de persuasion facilitent les interactions que vous avez avec les différents services de l'institution. Vous êtes en mesure de gérer plusieurs tâches de manière simultanée (gestion des priorités, hiérarchisation des demandes, flexibilité). De très bonnes aptitudes en communication française, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit, vous sont demandées ainsi que des connaissances de l'allemand ou de l'anglais. Votre esprit d'équipe et votre facilité à intégrer un nouvel environnement sont essentiels pour rejoindre l'institution et l'équipe de la DAI. \*\*Informations supplémentaires\*\* \* Entrée en fonction : à définir \* Nombre de poste : 1 \* Taux d'activité : 100% \* Classe de fonction : 21 \* Contrat : CDI \* Délai de candidature : \* Demande de renseignements : M. title: Technicien·ne systèmes et réseaux - solutions B2B
description: Chez ello, notre vision est de faire du monde digital une expérience humaine. Connecter est notre métier. Notre secteur d’activité, les télécommunications, nous plonge dans un univers stimulant où se construisent les technologies du futur. Nous sommes le fournisseur de connectivité leader de Neuchâtel et partenaire de Sunrise. Au cœur du digital, notre objectif est clair : offrir une expérience clientèle incomparable.Rejoins notre équipe en tant que :**Technicien·ne systèmes et réseaux – solutions B2B**Avant\-vente, projets et support**Tes missions**Tu aimes autant comprendre les besoins d’un client que résoudre un problème technique ? Chez ello, tu combines infrastructure IT, applications métiers et accompagnement des entreprises.* Tu participes à l’avant\-vente B2B : analyse des besoins, présentation des solutions et contribution au chiffrage.* Tu pilotes les projets techniques confiés et accompagnes les clients de la mise en service au support.* Tu secondes le responsable qualité dans la maintenance des applications métiers et les tests des mises à jour.* Tu exploites notre IT interne et assures sa sécurité, sa disponibilité et le support aux utilisateur·trices.* Tu participes au piquet de niveau 1 pour les réseaux backbone et HFC et les clients B2B sous contrat 24/7 : diagnostic, orientation des tickets et premiers dépannages réseau autorisés.**Ton profil et ta personnalité*** Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience en administration et exploitation d’infrastructures : Windows/Linux, virtualisation, stockage et postes de travail.* Tu maîtrises les fondamentaux réseau (TCP/IP, VLAN, routage, DNS/DHCP, VPN, Wi\-Fi, pare\-feu), la configuration des équipements et le diagnostic des incidents.* Tu sais sécuriser les accès et assurer les mises à jour, la supervision, les sauvegardes et la restauration des services.* Tu comprends les applications métiers et les services web et de messagerie, avec des bases en SQL et en scripts.* Autonome et méthodique, tu sais prioriser, documenter et escalader. À l’aise avec les clients, tu aimes expliquer la technique et souhaites t’impliquer dans l’avant\-vente et les projets B2B.* Cisco CCNA ou compétences équivalentes souhaitées. Des connaissances Cisco/Meraki et M\-Files sont des atouts.* Tu aimes apprendre et élargir tes compétences. Ouvert·e aux nouvelles approches, tu partages tes idées et proposes des améliorations concrètes.**Pourquoi nous rejoindre :**Chez ello, nous évoluons dans un secteur essentiel. Notre réseau fait fonctionner les entreprises, soigner les hôpitaux, enseigner les écoles et connecte chacun à ses proches. Tu pourras te changer les idées dans notre salle de repos et profiter de la possibilité de faire du télétravail et du remote office. title: Chef de secteur remontées mécaniques
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Chef de secteur remontées mécaniques--- Chef de secteur remontées mécaniques======================================Rejoins Portes du Portes du Suisse SA et participe à l’exploitation d’un des plus gros domaines de SuisseAvec près de 250 collaborateurs animés par l’amour de la montagne et l’envie de proposer des expériences inoubliables à nos visiteurs, nous faisons vivre le versant suisse des Portes du , de Champéry à Morgins. Notre mission : garantir des installations performantes et sécurisées, tout en offrant à nos visiteurs une expérience de montagne de qualité. **Ce que tu feras au quotidien** * **Sécurité et exploitation** : tu assures la responsabilité opérationnelle de ton secteur (environ 15 installations) et veilles à l'exploitation sûre, fiable et conforme des installations. Tu supervises les mises en service, les contrôles quotidiens et les mesures nécessaires pour garantir la sécurité des collaborateurs et des visiteurs. Tu prends les décisions de mise en service, de suspension ou d'arrêt des installations.* **Maintenance des installations** : tu planifies, coordonnes et contrôles les travaux de maintenance et d’inspection avec tes équipes et les sous\-traitants, afin de garantir des installations conformes et en bon état.* **Management d’équipe** : tu fédères, accompagnes et développes ton équipe au quotidien (environ 10 mécaniciens et électriciens annuels et 50 saisonniers). Tu organises le travail, définis les priorités, assures le suivi des compétences et contribues à instaurer une culture de sécurité, de responsabilité et de collaboration. Tout en garantissant le respect des lois et ordonnances (LDT, OLDT).* **Incidents et urgences** : tu coordonnes les interventions en cas de panne ou d'incident et assures le suivi des événements. Tu analyses les situations rencontrées et mets en œuvre les mesures correctives nécessaires.* **Gestion des ressources** : tu assures le suivi des besoins en matériel, des stocks et des commandes de ton secteur. Tu participes à la planification des budgets de maintenance et veilles à une utilisation efficiente des ressources humaines et matérielles.**Ton profil****Ce que tu apportes*** Le brevet fédéral de spécialiste des installations de transport à câbles (au minimum tu es inscrit au cursus ou en voie de le faire)* Un CFC dans un domaine technique ou une formation jugée équivalente.* De l'aisance avec MS Office et les tâches administratives.* Un état d’esprit collaboratif, rigoureux et organisé**Qui tu es*** Proactif et dynamique : tu prends des initiatives, en équipe comme en autonomie.* Passionné de montagne : même si ton travail se passe surtout en intérieur, le rythme saisonnier et la variété des missions te motivent.* Disponible : Tu es conscient des spécificités d'une activité touristique saisonnière et apprécies un rythme de travail varié, avec une disponibilité accrue durant les périodes d'exploitation hivernale.**Ce que nous te proposons**Un **poste de chef de secteur remontées mécaniques à 80\-100%**, dans un cadre magnifique où **passion et métier se rejoignent**. Rejoins\-nous pour vivre une expérience professionnelle différente, relever des défis stimulants et contribuer au développement touristique de notre région.**Avantages*** Cadre de travail convivial stimulant les compétences professionnelles et humaines* Employeur à taille humaine s’impliquant dans le développement de la région* Gratuité sur l’ensemble des remontées mécaniques des Portes du et avantages en Suisse* Place de parc gratuite sur le lieu de travail* Avantages auprès de nombreux partenaires* Assurances surobligatoiresEntrée à convenir.![Portes du Suisse SA]()* Portes du Suisse SA  Route de la 15  1874 Champéry*jidd8fae0cjm jit1145jm jiy26jm

Key Account Manager (f/m/x)
===========================

Your Responsibilities
---------------------

* You will drive business growth by identifying, qualifying, and converting new sales opportunities across assigned markets and key accounts
* You will develop and maintain long\-term customer relationships, ensuring high customer satisfaction, retention, and sustainable business growth
* You will prepare and present technical and commercial proposals, tenders and quotations, lead contract negotiations, and manage sales opportunities throughout the entire sales cycle
* You will define and execute the territory sales strategy, ensuring the achievement of sales, profitability, and growth targets
* You will manage and develop a strong sales pipeline, maintain CRM transparency, and ensure accurate forecasting and opportunity tracking
* You will promote aftermarket solutions and services, including spare parts, maintenance, LTSA business, overhauls, upgrades, retrofits, and digital services in collaboration with the Aftermarket Business Development Manager
* You will analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive activities to identify new business opportunities and support strategic decision\-making
* You will foster cross\-functional collaboration to ensure seamless project execution, successful customer handovers, and equipment reliability


Your Profile
------------

* You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering Business Administration, or an equivalent commercial or technical qualification with relevant professional experience
* You have proven experience in the diesel and gas engine business, combined with strong market knowledge about the energy sector
* You bring extensive experience in sales, key account management, and the successful delivery of complex commercial and technical projects
* You possess advanced negotiation and contract management skills, enabling you to successfully manage complex commercial agreements and customer relationships
* You demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders and foster alignment across functions
* You build strong and trusting relationships with customers and stakeholders through active listening, clear communication, and constructive feedback
* You proactively take ownership of initiatives, identify opportunities for improvement, and drive solutions to successful outcomes
* You are fluent in English and German; French language skills is considered an asset


Our Offer
---------

Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family\-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us.

In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email.

*This position is subject to a background check process; the process is conducted by our partner Aequivalent.*

Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sylvain STUDER.

**One Passion. Many Opportunities.**

The company
-----------

​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace.

Responsable du montage (H/F) – 100 %
======================================

***À propos de l'entreprise***  
*L'identité de l'entreprise reste confidentielle. Cette opportunité est proposée à titre exceptionnel aux entreprises suisses clientes de JobCloud, à condition qu'elles puissent démontrer à JobCloud l'existence d'un besoin légitime de confidentialité (par exemple, pour des raisons organisationnelles ou stratégiques). Dans ce cas, le nom de l'entreprise n'apparaît pas dans l'offre d'emploi. L'entreprise est seule responsable du processus de recrutement et du respect de la réglementation en matière de protection des données. Elle révèle, à sa seule discrétion, son identité au cours du processus de recrutement.*

 

Pour renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons une personne de terrain capable d’organiser les chantiers, d’encadrer l’équipe de montage et de participer activement à la réalisation de nos ouvrages métalliques.

**Vos responsabilités**

* Organiser, coordonner et superviser les travaux de montage sur les chantiers.
* Planifier les interventions et anticiper les besoins en personnel, en matériel et en outillage, en collaboration avec le bureau technique.
* Lire et interpréter les plans et les dossiers techniques afin de garantir une exécution conforme.
* Encadrer et accompagner l’équipe sur le terrain, répartir les tâches et contrôler leur bonne réalisation.
* Participer activement au montage des ouvrages métalliques et aux travaux de finition.
* Veiller au respect des délais, des exigences de qualité et des règles de sécurité.
* Assurer la coordination sur place avec les clients, les architectes et les autres intervenants.
* Identifier les difficultés techniques, proposer des solutions adaptées et signaler rapidement les écarts au bureau technique.
* Contrôler la qualité des travaux à chaque étape et leur conformité avant la réception.
* Veiller à la bonne utilisation et à l’entretien du matériel, de l’outillage et des véhicules.
* Participer aux travaux en atelier selon les besoins.


**Votre profil**

* CFC de constructeur métallique ou formation jugée équivalente dans la serrurerie ou la métallerie.
* Expérience confirmée dans le montage d’ouvrages métalliques en Suisse.
* Expérience dans l’encadrement d’une équipe ou la conduite de travaux de montage, un atout important.
* Très bonne maîtrise de la lecture de plans techniques.
* Bonne connaissance des exigences de qualité et des règles de sécurité applicables aux chantiers en Suisse.
* Capacité à organiser le travail, à anticiper les besoins et à prendre des initiatives adaptées.
* Personnalité autonome, fiable et rigoureuse, avec un sens marqué des responsabilités.
* Goût du travail précis et soigné.
* Esprit d’équipe et aisance dans les échanges avec les différents intervenants.
* Bonne maîtrise du français.
* Permis de conduire de catégorie B.


**Nous vous offrons**

* Un poste à responsabilités, avec une réelle autonomie sur le terrain.
* Des projets variés en construction métallique, pour des clients publics et privés.
* Une entreprise à taille humaine, favorisant les échanges directs et la collaboration.
* Un environnement de travail où votre savoir\-faire et votre implication sont valorisés.
* Une activité principalement en Suisse romande.


**Intéressé(e) ?**

Vous aimez le travail de terrain, savez fédérer une équipe et accordez une grande importance à la qualité des réalisations ? Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature.

Merci de transmettre votre dossier selon les modalités indiquées dans l’annonce, en précisant la fonction « Responsable du montage » et votre disponibilité.

Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant \[ici\](\< ;p8kVMJchPR0\>). Il œuvre au développement des prestations de pointe et des pôles de compétence de spécialité. Le service de gynécologie des HUG est l'un des plus importants de Suisse. Il compte de nombreuses spécialités, notamment en oncologie, en périnéologie ou encore en \[médecine de la reproduction\](\< \>). Le service assure également des consultations spécialisées autour de l'ovaire et des \[mutilations génitales féminines\](\< \>). Il prend en charge les femmes victimes d'\[agressions et violence\](\< \>), ou en demande d'un \[contrôle gynécologique\](\< \>), d'une \[contraception\](\< \>) ou d'une \[interruption de grossesse\](\< \>). Notre \[centre du sein\](\< \>) et notre \[centre d'endométriose\](\< \>) sont accrédités, offrant la garantie d'une prise en soins multidisciplinaire, globale et de qualité. Sales Support Defense (m/f/x)
=============================

Your responsibilities
---------------------

* You will support the Key Account Managers in maintaining customer relationships and ensuring efficient communication and follow\-up with designated Defense customers;

* You will assist in gathering and consolidating customer information, requirements and business data to support commercial activities and opportunity management;

* You will contribute to the monitoring of market developments, customer activities and competitor trends to support strategic decision\-making and business growth;

* You will support the preparation and maintenance of customer action plans, reports and commercial documentation in alignment with company objectives;

* You will coordinate and prepare customer reviews and strategic meetings to support long\-term customer relationships and business development;

* You will support bid preparation, proposal management and quotation activities by coordinating internal contributors, collecting required information and ensuring timely submissions;

* You will collaborate closely with management, product sales teams and other internal stakeholders to align customer requirements with company capabilities and priorities;

* You will support commercial reporting and sales performance tracking through data preparation, analysis and regular updates of relevant systems and tools;

* You will ensure compliance with applicable Defense, security and regulatory requirements while handling sensitive information with the highest level of professionalism and confidentiality.

Your profile
------------

* You hold a degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a comparable field.

* You have initial experience in sales support, project coordination, account management or a similar commercial environment.

* You possess initial knowledge of the Defense industry or have a strong interest in developing expertise in this field.

* You are organized, detail\-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

* You possess strong communication and interpersonal skills and enjoy collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders.

* You have a customer\-oriented mindset and take a proactive approach to supporting business activities.

* You demonstrate discretion and professionalism when handling confidential and sensitive information.

* You are fluent in English and German; French is considered an asset.

Our offer
---------

Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family\-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us.

 

In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email.

Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Sina WAUSCHKUHN.

**One Passion. Many Opportunities.**

The company
-----------

​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace.

title: Mitarbeiter Gebäudeunterhalt 100% (m/w/i)
description: nach VereinbarungMitarbeiter Gebäudeunterhalt 100% (m/w/i)nach Vereinbarung  Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.  Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.  Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit Stolz erfüllt.  Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir nach Vereinbarung eine Persönlichkeit als  Zu Ihrem abwechslungsreichen Hauptaufgabengebiet gehören unter anderem:* Mitarbeit bei der Durchführung der Wartungs\-, Unterhalts\- und Instandsetzungsarbeiten im Gebäudeunterhalt* Dienstleitung intern im Gebäudeunterhalt (allgemeiner Werkhofdienst)* Leisten von Pikettdienst (ca. 7 Tage/ 24h in regelmässigen Abständen /Pikett\-Turnus)* Begleiten der externen Dienstleister im Fachbereich* Mithilfe im Winterdienst und im Werkhof* Nachhaltige Reparaturen aller ArtSie haben eine Ausbildung als Fachmann Betriebsunterhalt EFZ und bringen handwerkliches Geschick mit. Sie sind zuverlässig, belastbar und teamfähig. Exaktes, gut strukturiertes Arbeiten und ruhiges, effizientes Agieren in hektischen Phasen sind Ihre Stärke. Wir setzen ein gepflegtes, freundliches und zuvorkommendes Auftreten voraus. Fremdsprachen sind ein Vorteil im Umgang mit unseren Mitarbeitern und Gästen. title: Head of Commercial Sales
description: Postulation : https://international-skating-union.ilucca.ch/recruitment/job-opportunities/9/job-offerThe RoleThe Head of Commercial Sales will define and lead the ISU’s global commercial sales strategy, with overall accountability for sustainable revenue growth across sponsorship, strategic partnerships and new commercial opportunities. Reporting to the Chief Commercial & Marketing Officer, the role will establish the ISU’s approach to market, set commercial priorities and revenue targets, and build a high-performing sales function capable of securing and growing high-value, multi-year partnerships.As the senior commercial sales lead, the role combines strategic leadership with direct responsibility for major business development. The successful candidate will personally originate and close complex opportunities, represent the ISU with C-suite decision-makers and ensure that commercial propositions reflect the full value of the ISU’s global events, disciplines, audiences and digital platforms.The Head of Commercial Sales will create the strategy, structures, processes and market relationships required to deliver ambitious short- and long-term revenue growth. While the role is primarily focused on new business, it will also provide senior oversight of partner value, renewals and the effective transition of signed agreements into delivery.Key ResponsibilitiesCommercial Strategy & Revenue Leadership:- Define and own the ISU’s global commercial sales strategy, translating organisational priorities into a clear multi-year revenue plan.- Set annual revenue targets, sector priorities, market-development plans and performance measures, with accountability for delivery against agreed commercial objectives.- Lead the development of a diversified and sustainable commercial portfolio across sponsorship, partnerships and other revenue-generating opportunities.- Advise the Chief Commercial & Marketing Officer and senior leadership on commercial opportunities, investment priorities, risks and market positioning.- Own sales forecasting, pipeline quality, pricing discipline and commercial reporting, ensuring accurate and timely visibility of performance.Business Development & Strategic Sales:- Personally originate, develop and close high-value, multi-year commercial agreements with global and regional brands.- Build and maintain a strong qualified pipeline by leveraging an established network and creating new relationships with brands, agencies and senior decision-makers.- Lead senior-level pitches, presentations and negotiations, taking responsibility for commercial terms, internal approvals and successful contract conclusion.- Prioritise and develop opportunities across strategic sectors including technology, AI and innovation, consumer electronics, financial services, travel, automotive, luxury, FMCG, health and wellness, and telecommunications.Commercial Proposition, Rights & Innovation: - Direct the development of compelling, insight-led commercial propositions aligned with partner objectives and the ISU’s strategic priorities.- Establish pricing principles and lead rights valuation, packaging and inventory management to maximise revenue while protecting long-term value.- Identify and develop new commercial assets and revenue platforms across events, digital, content, data, licensing, hospitality and fan engagement.- Ensure proposals are commercially robust, operationally deliverable and supported by a clear assessment of value, cost, risk and return.Functional Leadership & Sales Excellence:- Build and lead the commercial sales function, including employees, consultants, agencies and other external sales resources as required.- Create clear sales processes, governance, CRM discipline and performance standards to support effective prioritisation and execution.- Allocate opportunities and resources effectively, coach colleagues involved in commercial development and foster a high-performance, accountable culture.- Manage relevant sales budgets and external resources in line with agreed priorities and return expectations.Senior Stakeholder & Partner Leadership:- Represent the ISU in senior-level discussions with global brands, agencies, rights holders, event organisers and other strategic stakeholders.- Build trusted C-suite relationships with prospective and existing partners, positioning the ISU as an innovative and credible global partner.- Provide senior oversight of the transition from sale to delivery, ensuring commitments are clear, achievable and effectively handed over to activation and servicing teams.- Oversee renewal strategy for priority partners and intervene at senior level where required to protect value and long-term relationships.Cross-Functional & Organisational Leadership:- Work with marketing, communications, digital, events, broadcast, legal and finance colleagues to create integrated, deliverable and commercially sound solutions.- Partner with ISU leadership, Member Federations and event organisers to identify and unlock commercial opportunities across global events and year-round properties.- Champion a commercially focused culture and improve organisational understanding of the value, use and protection of ISU commercial rights. Market Intelligence, Governance & Performance:- Monitor sponsorship trends, competitor activity and relevant market developments to identify opportunities and maintain a differentiated proposition.- Provide clear monthly and quarterly reporting on revenue, pipeline, conversion, forecast accuracy, market activity and key risks.- Ensure sales activity and agreements comply with internal governance, delegated authority, legal requirements and the ISU’s ethical standards.- Use data, insight and post-deal evaluation to improve commercial decision-making, proposition development and sales performance.Expected profileEssential:- At least 10 years’ progressive experience in sponsorship sales, commercial partnerships, rights-holder business development or a comparable commercial discipline, including significant experience at senior leadership level.- Proven accountability for ambitious annual revenue targets and a strong record of originating, negotiating and closing high-value, multi-year international agreements.- Demonstrated experience defining and delivering a commercial sales strategy across multiple markets, sectors or properties.- Experience leading and developing employees, consultants, agencies or international sales resources, with the ability to create accountability and high performance.- Established network of senior brand, agency and commercial decision-makers, with the credibility to operate confidently at C-suite and board level.- Strong understanding of rights valuation, pricing, packaging, commercial contracting, forecasting and pipeline management.- Exceptional negotiation, presentation and influencing skills, together with sound judgement and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.- International Rattachée à la Direction médicale et qualité des HUG, la pharmacie a pour mission d'assurer un approvisionnement des médicaments fiable et réactif, de la pharmacie aux unités de soins, en anticipant les risques du marché, de fabriquer des médicaments sur mesure dans le respect des normes de qualité pour améliorer la sécurité d'utilisation, d'offrir une expertise au service des professionnels et professionnelles de santé et de la patientèle, pour optimiser la prise en charge médicamenteuse de la prescription à l'administration et d'être un centre de référence et de compétences dans la formation, l'enseignement et la recherche, en intégrant des méthodes innovantes. \*\*Description du poste\*\* Vous participez, avec les préparatrices et préparateurs en pharmacie, les logisticiens et logisticiennes et les assistantes et assistants en pharmacie, à l'activité de pharmacien ou pharmacienne de routine de l'Unité de logistique pharmaceutique de la pharmacie des HUG. Vous assurez, sous la supervision des pharmaciennes et pharmaciens chefs de projets et adjoints ou adjointes, au bon fonctionnement de l'approvisionnement en médicaments et leur mise à disposition auprès des patients. En collaboration avec deux autres pharmaciens et pharmaciennes, vous êtes le ou la référente pour les demandes diverses des médecins et unités de soins en lien avec l'obtention des médicaments, vous supervisez la gestion des ruptures, vous gérez les stocks de stupéfiants illicites. Vous assurez le suivi des prescriptions des médicaments critiques. Vous pilotez le processus de contrôle et retrait de lots avec le responsable assurance qualité. Vous garantissez la mise en application de la politique du médicament et des procédures de qualité et de sécurité. Vous contribuez à l'amélioration continue de l'organisation, en collaboration étroite avec les autres pharmaciens et pharmaciennes de l'unité, y compris en participant aux séances transversales avec d'autres unités ou services (pharmacie clinique, production). Vous participez à la formation et l'encadrement de collaboratrices et collaborateurs de la Pharmacie y compris apprenants et apprenantes (MAS, stagiaires). \*\*Qualifications\*\* Vous disposez du diplôme fédéral de pharmacien ou pharmacienne ou titre jugé équivalent. Vous êtes au bénéfice d'une expérience notable dans l'organisation et la coordination des activités reliées au circuit du médicament. Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences dans l'utilisation des outils informatiques (bureautique et gestion logistique). Vous avez le sens de l'organisation et des priorités, êtes autonome et apportez une grande rigueur dans votre travail. On reconnaît en vous votre aptitude à travailler en équipe, votre aisance relationnelle, votre esprit de collaboration, votre bon sens de la communication et une excellente résistance au stress. Vous avez une parfaite maîtrise du français, si possible de l'allemand ou de l'anglais et une aisance rédactionnelle. Une expérience réussie d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine hospitalier, une spécialisation terminée en pharmacie hospitalière (MAS, FPH, DES) sont des atouts substantiels. \*\*Informations supplémentaires\*\* \* Entrée en fonction : \* Nombre de postes : 1 \* Taux d'activité : 50% \* Classe de fonction : 19 \* Contrat : CDD \* Délai de candidature : \* Demande de renseignements : Mme M. Excellence:- Build and lead the commercial sales function, including employees, consultants, agencies and other external sales resources as required.- Create clear sales processes, governance, CRM relationships.Cross-Functional & Organisational Leadership:- Work with marketing, communications, digital, events, broadcast, legal and finance colleagues to create integrated, deliverable and delegated authority, legal requirements and the ISU’s ethical standards.- Use data, insight and post-deal evaluation to improve commercial decision-making, proposition development and sales performance.Expected profileEssential:- At least 10 years’ progressive experience in sponsorship sales, commercial partnerships, rights-holder business development or a comparable commercial discipline, including significant experience at senior leadership level.- Proven accountability for ambitious annual revenue targets and a strong record of originating, negotiating and closing high-value, multi-year international agreements.- Demonstrated experience defining and delivering a commercial sales strategy across multiple markets, sectors or properties.- Experience leading and developing employees, consultants, agencies or international sales resources, with the ability to create accountability and high performance.- Established network of senior brand, agency and commercial decision-makers, with the credibility to operate confidently at C-suite and board level.- Strong understanding of rights valuation, pricing, packaging, commercial contracting, forecasting and pipeline management.- Exceptional negotiation, presentation and influencing skills, together with sound judgement and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.- International skills.Desirable:- Senior commercial experience within an international sports federation, rights holder, major sporting event, media or entertainment organisation.- Experience developing new Service Data Scientist (m/f/x)
==============================

Your Responsibilities
---------------------

* You take ownership of the Sales analytics domain, providing data\-driven insights into actual sales performance and untapped sales potential

* You provide customer and sales insights to support portfolio, pricing and go\-to\-market decisions
* You share accountability with Sales for realizing jointly identified sales potential, as measured against agreed KPIs
* You ensure reliable and consistent sales figures through harmonized definitions across the team and follow up on CRM data quality issues with the responsible data owners until resolution
* You provide early warnings of relevant developments in sales performance and hit rates, and proactively propose automation and process improvements to reduce manual effort
* You ensure business continuity through up\-to\-date documentation and mutual deputyship during absences

------------

* You hold a Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Industrial Engineering or a related field

You are curious, work independently and have strong coordination skills across different departments. You enjoy working in a cross\-functional and international environment

title: Head of Footwear Development - Football
description: In short- Based at our Zurich HQ, you will be the visionary force and executive technical leader driving On’s entry and dominance in Football footwear. In this pivotal role, you will champion groundbreaking creation, build a world-class team, and fearlessly disrupt traditional manufacturing processes to engineer the most premium, disruptive performance products in the industry.- As Head of Football Footwear Development, you will seamlessly connect the granular with the macro-strategic—serving as the ultimate technical authority while shaping the long-term vision for On’s newest and most critical category. By ensuring absolute synergy between radical design vision, elite biomechanical performance, and next-generation manufacturing feasibility, you will set the benchmark for football footwear creation. You will provide the technical governance, cross-functional leadership, and pioneering strategy needed to build our football department from the ground up, driving innovation straight into our inline product strategy while scaling the category globally.- This role reports directly to the Head of Innovation Footwear, leading the dedicated Zurich-based Football Development team and partnering closely with global footwear leadership.Your Mission- Strategic & Disruptive Leadership: Define and execute the overarching technical and development strategy for Football footwear. Pioneer the adoption of agile, disruptive manufacturing methods and next-generation tooling to bypass traditional constraints.- Inline Innovation Engine: Drive category-defining innovation directly from the inline development process, elevating brand equity, performance standards, and technological capabilities across the broader organization.- Technical & Category Governance: Serve as the final technical authority during briefing, design, and execution phases—ensuring football-specific demands (traction, stud configuration, upper lockdown, ball feel, and touch) meet rigorous scientific standards.- Strategic Global Synchronization: Lead high-level alignment between Zurich-based Design, Product Management, Biomechanics, and Asia-based development and manufacturing partners, safeguarding the performance "soul" of the football category across all franchises.- Team Building & Talent Empowerment: Build, mentor, and scale a elite team of developers and engineers, inspiring a culture of relentless curiosity, technical rigor, and hands-on experimentation.- Manufacturing & Supply Chain Evolution: Identify technical bottlenecks and transform global supply chain capabilities by partnering with tier-1 suppliers and novel manufacturing vendors to enable quick-turn, high-agility production.- Elite Performance & Quality Assurance: Establish and oversee category-wide validation benchmarks for fit, feel, traction, energy return, and long-term durability across all factory partners.Your Story- Experience: 10–15+ years of deep expertise in footwear development, with a proven track record specifically within high-performance Football (Soccer) footwear.- Disruptive Mindset: Highly adaptable with demonstrated experience implementing unconventional, agile, or disruptive manufacturing methods (e.g., advanced automation, additive manufacturing, 3D/textile innovation, automated bonding).- Proven Executive Leadership: Experience building, leading, and mentoring technical teams, with the executive presence to influence product management, design, and external partners at the highest levels.- Deep Domain Mastery: Comprehensive understanding of football-specific biomechanics, plate dynamics, stud pressure distribution, specialized last development, and upper material behavior under match conditions.- Systemic & Commercial Vision: Exceptional ability to balance high-risk/high-reward innovation with commercial viability and global supply chain scalability.- Collaborative & Culturally Agile: A natural bridge builder capable of translating creative vision into technical reality across diverse, multi-regional teams (HQ to Asia execution).- Communication: Fluency in English (verbal and written) with exceptional consultative and strategic presentation skills.Attributes of a successful candidate:- The Master Craftsman & Innovator: Deeply knowledgeable in football footwear heritage, yet obsessed with tearing down old rules to build radical new systems.- The Visionary Architect: Focuses on both the "how" and the "where next," ensuring the football category’s technical roadmap pushes the limits of physics and athlete capability.- The System Disrupter: Thrives on agility—able to pivot quickly, challenge traditional manufacturing timelines, and integrate cutting-edge concepts into inline production.Your Team- You will lead the Zurich-based Football Footwear Development team.- We are an innovative, creative, and science-driven team dedicated to converting cutting-edge ideas into high-performance footwear. Driven by constant curiosity and an unrelenting ambition, we are a collective built to disrupt: constantly breaking the system only to rebuild it as the most innovative brand in football.- In Zurich, our team acts as the primary link between Biomechanical Research, Material Science, Design, and Sourcing, ensuring that every innovation is grounded in technical reality before it reaches the pitch. Our team combines deep expertise in engineering, development, and product management to create gear that meets rigorous scientific and technical standards. We foster a hands-on, highly collaborative environment where experts work alongside the very best in their respective fields.- United by a shared obsession with excellence, we will never stop on our quest to redefine the game and create the world’s best football products, time and time again. As the Head of this team, you will lead this high-performance heart of the category, ensuring our technical standards and performance identity remain uncompromised as we expand.
